columns.name: In Progress
columns.prompt: Claim the card: `repodoc card update repodoc <card> --agent <you> --live true --status "<one line>" --progress <n>`. Journal meaningful progress with `repodoc card comment` including `path:line` references. Keep status and progress honest.

columns.name: In Review

enter.label: All tests passing
enter.prompt: Run `bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun run test` from the repo root. Only when every command exits 0, record the summary line (e.g. "239 pass") with `repodoc card gate-pass repodoc <card> tests-passing "<summary>"`.

enter.label: change-review skill run
enter.prompt: Stage the change (`git add -A`) and run the `change-review` skill over the staged diff. Fix every `bug`/`issue` finding it raises and re-run until it reports none, then record the result with gate-pass.

enter.label: clean-code audit run
enter.prompt: Run the `clean-code-review` skill over the change. It tags violations as `TODO: clean-code - <score>` markers; clear every marker scoring above 0.5 (the `refactor` skill clears one per pass), re-run the tests, then record the result with gate-pass.

exit.label: All review comments addressed
exit.prompt: Every review comment on this card must be addressed. A human sets the `comments-addressed` field to true once satisfied — do not set it yourself.

exit.label: No clean-code violations
exit.prompt: Run `! grep -rn "TODO: clean-code" packages` — it must print nothing. Clear any marker it finds, then record the run with gate-pass.

columns.prompt: Set `--live false` and `--progress 100`. Add a final journal comment summarising what shipped and how it was verified. A human reviews from here; respond to review comments by journaling what you changed.

columns.name: Done

enter.label: Merged into main
enter.prompt: Only record this after the branch has actually merged: `git fetch origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main` must exit 0.

enter.label: Peer reviewed
enter.prompt: A human reviewer sets `peer-reviewed` to true. Do not set it yourself.

columns.prompt: Nothing more to do. Do not edit the card again.
